description: with xremap running and 'F9: F12' in its modmap, an unlisted 'a' from the VM kernel keyboard reaches the probe unchanged through xremap's uinput device; Hyprland finds no bind and the Input remapper layer does not redirect it. XKB_DEFAULT_LAYOUT=us is set because the VM's Hyprland layout is us and whykey reads the layout only from the environment
